mapper.select: SELECT id, case_id, run_id, interaction_type, prompt, options, response, case_interactions_status, created_at, responded_at FROM case_interactions WHERE ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit, jdbcType=INTEGER} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE case_interactions SET response = CAST(#{response, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb), case_interactions_status = 'ANSWERED', responded_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE AND id = #{interactionId} AND case_interactions_status = 'PENDING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO case_interactions ( case_id, run_id, interaction_type, prompt, response, case_interactions_status, responded_at ) VALUES ( #{caseId}, #{runId}, 'TEXT', #{prompt}, jsonb_build_object('requirement', CAST(#{requirement} AS text)), 'ANSWERED', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.sql: interaction.case_id = #{caseId} AND interaction.case_interactions_status = 'ANSWERED' AND interaction.interaction_type = 'TEXT' AND interaction.response ->> 'requirement' IS NOT NULL AND run.trigger_type = 'USER_INFO_UPDATED' AND starts_with(run.trigger_key, #{triggerKeyPrefix})
mapper.select: SELECT interaction.response ->> 'requirement' FROM case_interactions interaction JOIN orchestrator_runs run ON run.id = interaction.run_id WHERE ORDER BY interaction.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT interaction.response ->> 'requirement' FROM case_interactions interaction JOIN orchestrator_runs run ON run.id = interaction.run_id WHERE AND run.id = #{runId} ORDER BY interaction.id DESC LIMIT 1
